releaseNotes: First official release. Everything from the beta channel, now as 1.3.0: team rosters with names and numbers, reorderable game lineups that persist across games, team stats for every roster player, automatic personal stats for your flagged my player, opponent lineups (number and name), and walk-up music clips up to 1 minute per player. Pressing Play Music starts with a stadium-style announcer voice saying Now batting, number N, Name for whoever is actually at bat, with a PA-system echo, then the music plays at the phone volume, independent of the in-app sounds setting. The Now Batting banner is a solid navy bar with white text.
